scientific_integrity: The finite-horizon expected-work theorem is derived from the stated two-state Markov generator and proved analytically; 6636 bounded consistency checks support, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Constant fixed load, symmetric kinetic splitting, fixed finite-state Markov kinetics, known prepared population; no optimal-control claim for time-varying load, no full-cycle housekeeping accounting, no stochastic-work fluctuations. Publication priority is qualified by incomplete access to one broader finite-time discharge manuscript.
title: A sharp charge threshold for the direction of finite-horizon optimal battery loading
